column2: A late bus can disadvantage students who live far from school.
column3: 公車誤點會讓住得遠的學生處於不利地位。
column5: dis 相反 + advantage 優勢：讓人失去優勢

column2: Please disconnect the charger from the wall before you clean the lamp.
column3: 清潔檯燈前，請把充電器的電源從牆上切斷。
column5: dis 分開 + connect 連接：把連著的拔開

column2: Do not let one bad score discourage you from trying again.
column3: 別讓一次考不好就使你洩氣，不願再試。
column5: dis 去掉 + courage 勇氣：把勇氣拿走

column2: The spy tried to disguise himself as a street cleaner.
column3: 間諜試圖喬裝成清潔工。
column5: dis 去掉 + guise 外表：換掉外表讓人認不出

column2: The smell of rotten eggs can disgust anyone who walks into the kitchen.
column3: 臭雞蛋的味道會讓走進廚房的人感到噁心。
column5: dis 否 + gust 味道：嘗起來不對勁，讓人想吐

column2: Strong winds can disorder the papers on the desk in seconds.
column3: 強風幾秒鐘內就能把桌上的紙吹得亂七八糟。
column5: dis 否 + order 秩序：把秩序拿掉，就亂了

column2: Volunteers distribute free lunch boxes to children after the soccer game.
column3: 球賽後，志工把免費便當分發給孩子們。
column5: dis 分開 + tribute 給予：分成一份一份發出去

column2: After many years of conflict, the couple chose to divorce peacefully.
column3: 歷經多年爭執後，這對夫妻選擇和平離婚。
column5: di 分開：婚姻關係被分開了

column2: One tall player can dominate the game by blocking nearly every shot.
column3: 一位高個子球員幾乎擋下每一球，就能主宰整場比賽。
column5: domin 像主人：像一家之主般控制全場

column2: Grandpa likes to doze on the sofa after he finishes his lunch.
column3: 爺爺吃完午飯後喜歡在沙發上打盹。
column5: doze 像「豆子」：吃完豆子配軟沙發就想打盹

column2: The student council will draft a new rule for using the school gym.
column3: 學生會將起草使用學校體育館的新規定。
column5: draft 是草稿，把想法先寫在紙上

column2: Many children dread the dentist because of the sound of the drill.
column3: 許多孩子因為鑽頭的聲音而害怕看牙醫。
column5: dread 像「抓的」：心被抓住了，很害怕

column2: A small boat can drift for miles if nobody holds the oars.
column3: 沒有人划槳時，一艘小船能漂流好幾英里。
column4: drift on the sea (在海上漂)
column5: drift 像「抓緊」：不抓緊就會漂走

column2: She wants to dye her white scarf blue for the winter festival.
column3: 她想把白圍巾染成藍色去參加冬季慶典。
column5: dye 與 die 同音，但這是染色，要染上顏色

column2: Please email the photos to me tonight so I can print them tomorrow.
column3: 請今晚把照片用電子郵件寄給我，我明天才能印出來。
column4: email a photo (用電子郵件寄照片)
column5: e 是 electronic，mail 是信件：電子信件

column2: You can e-mail your homework to the teacher before midnight.
column3: 你可以在午夜前把作業用電子郵件寄給老師。
column4: e-mail a report (用電子郵件寄報告)
column5: e 是電子，mail 是郵件：電子郵件，連字號寫法

column2: It will embarrass him if you read his diary out loud.
column3: 如果你把他的日記大聲唸出來，會讓他很困窘。
column5: em 使 + barrass 擋路：被擋住動彈不得，很尷尬

column2: The sun began to emerge from behind the clouds after the rain.
column3: 雨後，太陽開始從雲後面浮現出來。
column4: emerge from the water (從水中浮出)
column5: e 出 + merge 沉：從水中浮出來，露出臉

column2: Farmers enclose the sheep with a wooden fence to keep them safe at night.
column3: 農夫用木籬笆把羊圍起來，讓牠們夜裡安全。
column5: en 使 + close 關：把它關在裡面，圍起來

column2: On the hike, we may encounter wild monkeys near the stream.
column3: 健行時，我們可能在溪邊遇到野生猴子。
column5: en 在 + counter 相對：正面碰上

column2: Dumping trash in the river will endanger the fish that live there.
column3: 把垃圾倒進河裡會危及住在那裡的魚。
column5: en 使 + danger 危險：讓牠們陷入危險

column2: We plan to enlarge the small photo so it fits on the wall.
column3: 我們打算把這張小照片放大，好讓它掛在牆上。
column5: en 使 + large 大：使它變大

column2: My parents like to entertain friends with homemade dumplings on weekends.
column3: 我父母週末喜歡用自製水餃招待朋友。
column5: enter 進來 + tain 握住：請客人進來，好好款待

column2: The school will equip every classroom with a new projector this year.
column3: 學校今年會為每間教室配備新的投影機。
column5: equip 像「一個皮」：給你一整套裝備

column2: The town plans to establish a library for children near the park.
column3: 鎮上計畫在公園附近建立一座兒童圖書館。
column5: est 站 + ablish：把根基穩穩立起來

column2: His smile evidences how much he enjoyed the school trip.
column3: 他的笑容顯示出他有多喜歡這趟校外旅行。
column5: evidence 是證據，當動詞就是把證據擺出來

column2: A long run in the heat can exhaust even a strong athlete.
column3: 在高溫下長跑可能使連強壯的運動員都精疲力盡。
column5: ex 出 + haust 汲取：把力氣全部汲光

column2: Metal will expand when it gets hot, so the rails are built with small gaps.
column3: 金屬受熱會膨脹，所以鐵軌留有小縫隙。
column5: ex 向外 + pand 展開：向外展開，變大

column2: Scientists use robots to explore the deep sea where people cannot go.
column3: 科學家用機器人探測人類去不了的深海。
column5: ex 出 + plore 呼喊：大叫著出發去找新地方

column2: Do not expose the film to bright light, or the pictures will be spoiled.
column3: 別讓底片暴露在強光下，否則照片會壞掉。
column5: ex 向外 + pose 放：放到外面去，不遮不擋

column2: The villagers feast the guests with fish, rice, and sweet cakes.
column3: 村民們用魚、飯和甜糕盛宴款待客人。
column4: feast the guests (盛宴款待客人)
column5: feast 像「飛司」：吃到飛起來的大餐

column2: Please fetch my coat from the car before the rain starts.
column3: 請在下雨前去車裡幫我把外套拿來。
column5: fetch 像「飛去」：飛奔過去再拿回來

column2: The club will hold a bake sale to finance a trip to the museum.
column3: 社團將舉辦烘焙義賣，籌措去博物館的旅費。
column4: finance a project (籌措計畫資金)
column5: finance 是金融，當動詞就是出錢支持

column2: Do not flatter your teacher just to get a higher grade.
column3: 不要為了拿高分而奉承你的老師。
column5: flatter 像「福利特」：嘴巴甜，只說好聽話

column2: The villagers had to flee when the river rose over the bank.
column3: 河水漲過堤岸時，村民不得不逃離。
column5: flee 像「飛」：快飛快跑地逃走

column2: If you never study, you may flunk the math test at the end of term.
column3: 如果你完全不讀書，期末的數學考試可能會不及格。
column5: flunk 像「福蘭克」：福氣沒了，成績也沒了

column2: Please flush the toilet and wash your hands before you leave.
column3: 離開前請沖馬桶並洗手。
column5: flush 像「福拉屎」：沖掉用水往下流

column2: The soda began to foam when I poured it into a cup too fast.
column3: 我把汽水倒進杯子太快時，它開始起泡沫。
column4: foam at the mouth (口吐泡沫)
column5: foam 像「佛恩」：佛恩降臨，冒出一片白泡泡

column2: The school rules forbid students from running in the halls.
column3: 校規禁止學生在走廊奔跑。
column5: for 拒絕 + bid 命令：發命令說不可以

column2: Meteorologists forecast heavy rain for Friday, so bring an umbrella.
column3: 氣象學家預測星期五有大雨，所以記得帶傘。
column5: fore 事先 + cast 投擲：把目光先投向未來
